start_discord_channel: start the DiscordChannel bot with a MessageBus and config containing bot_token and optional allowed_guilds
stop_discord_channel: stop the running DiscordChannel bot, closing the client and joining the daemon thread with a 10s timeout
send_discord_message: send a text OutboundMessage to a Discord channel or thread, auto-splitting text exceeding 2000 characters
send_discord_file: upload a file attachment to a Discord channel or thread using ResolvedAttachment with the actual file path
split_discord_text: split a long text string into chunks under 2000 characters by finding newline boundaries for Discord message limits
